session_policy: One live Session; one top-level statement per submission. No restarts.

attempts.lesson: Existing quotient/remainder interface checks directly for an integer dividend and positive natural divisor.
Natural-square nonnegativity checks without a source-level cast transport.

translation_records.source: Self-contained type-bridge experiment; existing quotient/remainder benchmark interface.
translation_records.problem: For an integer a and positive natural d, a equals d times its quotient plus its remainder.
translation_records.proof_idea: Use the existing integer quotient/remainder identity with a positive divisor.
translation_records.comments: Checked in one strict Session and then by a clean release -f run. No user trust or axiom. The native verifier rules remain trusted.

translation_records.problem: For every natural number n, its square is nonnegative. The Lean statement views n in the reals.
translation_records.proof_idea: Use the native nonnegativity fact for a square; Litex uses one numeric object across the natural and real memberships.
translation_records.comments: Checked in the same strict Session and by clean release -f. No user trust. This is a matched arithmetic target, not an isolated measure of type-system costs.
